title: lepechinia hirsuta
intro: Lepechinia hirsuta, commonly known as Hoja de Fraile, is a plant species native to Mexico and Central America, belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and showing antimicrobial activity. The therapeutic actions of Lepechinia hirsuta include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lepechinia hirsuta include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
